plates.fact: The 2025 plates cleared a backlog and were not a mass replating, so older Morelos plates are still common on the road.

notes: The Coordinación Estatal de Movilidad y Transporte announced new plates, cards and licences in Apr 2025, with appointments from 15 Apr 2025 at citas.morelos.gob.mx. The design description comes only from sdpnoticias (2025); confirm it before use. No official image was found.
